feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Zelenskyy talks Trump, rising diesel prices and the ongoing war in his country
entry.summary: In an NPR interview, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy discusses tensions with Trump, U.S. sanctions relief for Russian oil and threats to intelligence-sharing as the war continues.

entry.title: Diplomat Richard Haass discusses the Russia-Ukraine war and Trump's role
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with veteran diplomat Richard Haass about the Russia-Ukraine war and the role President Trump is playing.

entry.title: Trump takes campaign tour to Alaska as rallies for GOP candidates continue
entry.summary: President Donald Trump traveled to the red state of Alaska on Tuesday, to rally in support of an endangered Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan.

entry.title: U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns following misconduct allegations
entry.summary: President Trump has forced out his ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle. She faced allegations of misconduct before and during her tenure at the U.S. Embassy in Athens, which she has denied.

entry.title: Cornell's Faculty Senate considers no-confidence vote for school's president
entry.summary: Cornell says it's making big changes on campus following the allegations of a gang rape, but it remains under fire. The Faculty Senate is now discussing a no-confidence vote of the president.

entry.title: Textile factory workers in India are teaching AI how to do their jobs
entry.summary: Laborers in Indian textile factories are filming themselves working so developers can train AI to take over their jobs.

entry.title: Michael Che talks about his new comedy special, 'Michael Che: Shot in Minnesota'
entry.summary: Michael Che {chay} is one half of the Weekend Update team at "Saturday Night Live." NPR's A Martinez talks to him about his new Netflix stand-up comedy special, "Michael Che: Shot in Minnesota."

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy sits down with NPR to talks about the ongoing war in his country, Pope Leo has lung cancer, the Vatican announced, U.S. ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns.

entry.title: Labor Department to release latest inflation report
entry.summary: Higher energy prices, tied to the U.S. war with Iran, are driving up the overall cost-of-living. The Labor Department is set to deliver its latest inflation report this morning.

entry.title: Facing a labor shortage, Japanese chain goes 'GaGa' for recruitment effort
entry.summary: Facing a mounting labor crunch, Japan's second largest convenience store chain is "going Gaga."
